title: Knowledge runs record their actual cost (compute and model, per stage and per run)
description: Each stage of the cloud knowledge run records details.cost in its JobLedger row: Fargate seconds, vCPU, memory, computeUsd at the ARM us-east-1 rates, and model calls, tokens and USD from the API usage objects (null with a reason where unknown). Projection sums the run into a run-level ledger row and runs/<week>/cost-<execution>.json. CLI: papyrus knowledge runs --site <site> [--last N]. No console panel: the console has no knowledge-run status view. Out of scope: trend-drafts (after projection, not a stage).
